label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_01
text: Hello there! My name is Katy, and I am the owner\nof Patisserie Soapberry.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_02
text: Oh? The new Champion everybody is talking\nabout—is it actually you, sweetie?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_03
text: Hurray! I guessed correctly! I suppose that makes\nsense, though. You sure were strong![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_04
text: You really looked like you were enjoying yourself\nwhen you tried my sweet treats, too.\c\nPeople like that always have great potential.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_05
text: So you’re here on an errand for the Top\nChampion, are you?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_06
text: I had completely forgotten that she was\nsupposed to be going around for inspections![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_07
text: Thankfully, I just happened to be here today to\ngive cakes to my staff. Phew. Lucky me![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_08
text: Very well, then. Is it time for me to get a taste of\nour new Champion’s strength?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_retry
text: Oh? Are you here to let me have a taste of our\nnew Champion’s strength?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_09
text: Hehe. Oh, what fun! Let’s go somewhere more\nsuited for battling.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_010_mushi_10
text: Awww. Not yet? Do come back when you’re\ngood and ready![VAR 0x0114(0016)]
